records.question: Which production services did he personally design and operate?

response.answer: Bolaji personally designed and operated BigQuery, Apache Airflow, Dataform, Google Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Build for Gozem. For the Gozem Data Hub, he personally designed and operated AWS EC2. Additionally, he personally set up and operated AWS S3 in production as an exchange layer.

evidence.content_preview:
Source: 21_production_service_inventory.txt | Title: BOLAJI BALOGOUN - CONFIRMED PRODUCTION SERVICE INVENTORY | Section: PRODUCTION SERVICE INVENTORY | Parent context: BOLAJI BALOGOUN - CONFIRMED PRODUCTION SERVICE INVENTORY

For an unrestricted service list, lead with the documented operational core: BigQuery, Apache Airflow, Dataform and Google Cloud Storage. Follow with relevant streaming, application, AI, compute, delivery and observability services. BigQuery was the central warehouse used daily; Airflow orchestrated workflows and Dataform supplied production modeling and transformations. This presentation order follows the owner's preference for operational centrality and the documented platform roles, not a measured ranking of frequency, spend or business impact. A narrower provider or service question takes precedence.

Bolaji personally designed and operated the following documented production services as an architect and engineer:
Service inventory: BigQuery, Apache Airflow, Dataform, Google Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Vertex AI, AWS EC2, AWS S3, Artifact Registry, Cloud Logging and Cloud Build.
GCP services: BigQuery, Dataform, Google Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, Cloud Logging and Cloud Build.
AWS services: AWS EC2 and AWS S3.
Apache Airflow is documented orchestration software; this inventory does not infer a managed hosting provider for it.
- Warehouse and transformation at Gozem: BigQuery and Dataform. Supporting record: 05_skills_and_tools.txt, CLOUD & DATA PLATFORMS and DATA INGESTION & TRANSFORMATION; 90_website_canon_llms_full.txt, Data platform modernization and FinOps transformation. BigQuery operation was also explicitly reaffirmed by the owner.
- Storage at Gozem: Google Cloud Storage. Supporting record: 03_previous_role_gozem_gda.txt, cloud migration; 05_skills_and_tools.txt, CLOUD & DATA PLATFORMS.
- Orchestration at Gozem: Apache Airflow. Supporting record: 05_skills_and_tools.txt, DEVOPS & CI/CD; 13_gozem_internal_projects.txt, DATA QUALITY OBSERVABILITY SYSTEM. Airflow operation was explicitly reaffirmed by the owner.
- Streaming at Gozem: During his Head of Data role at Gozem (October 2022 to March 2025), Bolaji personally designed and operated Pub/Sub and Dataflow in production for the MongoDB CDC pipeline. The owner confirmed this role attribution on November 20, 2026. This is the role period, not exact project start or completion dates or proof of continuous operation throughout the period. Supporting record: 20_owner_confirmed_production_scope.txt, current clarification; 90_website_canon_llms_full.txt, application-ready data flows.
- Application and AI services at Gozem: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Vertex AI. Supporting record: 05_skills_and_tools.txt, CLOUD & DATA PLATFORMS and AI & LLM ENGINEERING; 18_confirmed_clarifications.txt, HANDS-ON VERTEX AI AND TECHNICAL SUPERVISION; 90_website_canon_llms_full.txt, Tech stack. Cloud Run is also used for the production iBola project. Personal service responsibility does not mean sole implementation of the recommendation model, its API or mobile integration.
- Delivery and observability at Gozem: Artifact Registry, Cloud Logging and Cloud Build. Supporting record: 05_skills_and_tools.txt, CLOUD & DATA PLATFORMS and DEVOPS & CI/CD, combined with the owner's design-and-operation confirmation.
- AWS compute: Bolaji personally designed and operated AWS EC2 in production for the Gozem Data Hub. Supporting record: 20_owner_confirmed_production_scope.txt.
- AWS storage: Bolaji personally designed and operated AWS S3 in production, including bucket setup and ongoing reading and writing as an exchange layer with the product team. The employer or project for that bucket is not specified. Supporting record: 20_owner_confirmed_production_scope.txt.

The personal responsibility above is owner-confirmed for the services actually used in these documented production contexts. The confirmation does not add Kafka experience, make projects or labs into production use, establish every upstream database's administration, or establish on-call responsibility or a service-level guarantee. Additional database and BI technologies have their own documented contexts in the skills and project records.

Source: 20_owner_confirmed_production_scope.txt | Title: OWNER-CONFIRMED PRODUCTION RESPONSIBILITY | Section: OWNER-CONFIRMED PRODUCTION RESPONSIBILITY

Confirmation recorded on November 19, 2026. This is the confirmation date, not a date assigned to the underlying work. Evidence classification: candidate_confirmed.

At Gozem, Bolaji personally designed and operated Pub/Sub and Dataflow in production for the MongoDB CDC pipeline. The owner subsequently clarified that he is both an architect and engineer and personally designed and operated the production services he used. This supersedes the earlier design-only qualification for these services.

For the Gozem Data Hub, Bolaji personally designed and operated AWS EC2 in production.

Bolaji personally set up an AWS S3 bucket in production. Bolaji personally operates an AWS S3 bucket in production, reading data from it and writing data back. He owns and operates the bucket on an ongoing basis. AWS S3 serves as an exchange layer with the product team and has also been used in projects. This clarification does not identify an employer or project for the S3 bucket and does not establish on-call responsibility.

Bolaji has no Kafka experience at all. Bolaji has never used Kafka. This is an explicit owner-confirmed absence of experience, not an inference from an omitted tool. It does not imply inability to learn Kafka or a deficiency in other streaming technologies.

These clarifications do not add personal Spark Structured Streaming, Apache NiFi or Lakeflow production experience. They do not establish CDC event counts, end-to-end latency or availability. The separately documented streaming-workload average remains a different measurement population.

CDC role and period, owner confirmation received November 20, 2026: During his Head of Data role at Gozem (October 2022 to March 2025), Bolaji personally designed and operated Pub/Sub and Dataflow in production for the MongoDB CDC pipeline.

This confirmation locates the CDC work within that role period. It does not establish the project's exact start or completion dates, continuous operation throughout the entire role, on-call coverage, latency or uptime guarantees. It does not assign that role period to AWS EC2, AWS S3 or other services. The earlier Google Cloud migration remains separately attributed to the Global Data Analyst role.

Confirmation provenance: Asked which role and period covered his design and operation of the MongoDB CDC pipeline, the owner answered: "Head of Data, Oct 2022–Mar 2025". Evidence classification: candidate_confirmed. The November 20 date records when this role clarification was received, not when the project started or ended.
